name: Maristan
mission: To offer culturally and religiously tailored mental health services, creating a secure haven for individuals to explore well-being within their faith. We strive to raise awareness about mental health in Muslim communities and beyond, breaking down stigmas and fostering a supportive environment for holistic healing.
theoryOfChange: Maristan operates based on a strategic framework referred to as the 'Maristan model' or 'Maristan blueprint' for holistic care. This model is a theoretical framework that acknowledges intertwined external and internal factors influencing psychological problems, incorporating aspects of an individual's body, mind, heart, and soul into diagnostic and treatment processes [14]. It is described as a 'blueprint for the future' where mind, body, and soul are cared for together [10]. The organization's approach integrates a bio-psycho-social-spiritual framework, drawing from historical Islamic institutions of healing (maristans) to provide culturally and spiritually congruent mental health care, psychoeducation, and training [17, 23, 13]. This framework emphasizes evidence-based modalities, cultural humility, faith integration, and community-based care [10]. The book 'Maristāns and Islāmic Psychology: A Historical Model for Modern Implementation,' co-authored by Maristan's President, Dr. Rania Awaad, further details this model in Chapter 6, 'The Maristān Blueprint: A Model for Holistic Care' [11, 14].
